data.name: Holiday Inn & Suites Monterrey Apodaca Zona Airport by IHG
data.address: Parque Industrial MILIMEX, Av. Miguel Alemán 120, El Milagro, 66601 Cdad. Apodaca, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
Located within a shopping mall off a busy highway, this relaxed hotel is 6 km from Parque Fundadores, 11 km from Monterrey International Airport and 18 km from Monterrey's lively Centro district.
Unfussy rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes, plus minibars and coffeemakers. Suites add living areas with sofabeds. Kids age 18 and under stay at no charge in a parent's room.
Secured parking is complimentary. A laid-back restaurant offers a breakfast buffet. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, a gym and a BBQ area, as well as a 24-hour business center.
